messages:
Devin: Uploaded a compact-rows prototype for the Vector Preview + Relevance Inspector. Figma link in thread. Quick look appreciated.
Priya: Love the compacting — feels less heavy on dashboard pages. On mobile though the row truncation hides the source domain. maybe add a `…` tooltip.
Evan: Agree on tooltip. Also the "score" column is ambiguous. Can we label as 'similarity (0-1)' or show percent? Small change but reduces support tickets.
Jordan: Tiny nit: the rank delta chevrons are green/red but lack textual hints. Add `aria-label="moved up 3 positions"` when applicable.
Casey: Export question: what formats do we want to persist? CSV + JSON seems required. For JSON, do we embed full metadata at top or sidecar file? I prefer metadata block at top: `{"metadata": {...}, "results": [...]}`.
Devin: Metadata at top is fine. Include: model_variant, rerank_params, seed, timestamp, original_batch_id. Keep keys stable.
Priya: For the preview, can we surface the original input snippet under each vector row collapsed by default? a small chevron to expand. helps debugging.
Evan: Performance: rendering 150 rows with embeddings + heatmap gets laggy. Consider swapping the heatmap to a canvas layer or prerendering SVGs.
a11y-bot: A11Y scan: color contrast issues on heatmap legend and small action icons. Recommend 4.5:1 contrast for body text and focusable controls must have 3px focus ring.
Jordan: Copy tweak: replace "Pin" with "Pin result" to be explicit in short screens.
Casey: CSV header example: `id,original_index,similarity_score,rerank_score,rank_delta,source,metadata_json` — make sure `metadata_json` is JSON-escaped.
Priya: Keyboard: when a row is expanded, focus should move into the expanded area and pressing `Esc` should collapse it. Also `Enter` to toggle expand.
Devin: UX decision: default sorting should be rerank_score desc, but allow a persistent toggle to view original similarity sort. Users requested quick switch.
Evan: Pagination vs load-more: prefer explicit "Load more" for huge batches — gives users control and avoids sudden memory spikes.
Devin: I'll iterate in Figma: add metadata block in export modal, update labels to "similarity (0-1)" and "Pin result", add keyboard affordances, and swap heatmap color ramps to accessible palette. Will post new link by tomorrow morning.
Priya: I'll run a quick keyboard-only walkthrough once updated.
Jordan: I'll add short copy suggestions in figma comments for the export modal microcopy.
Casey: I'll write the export schema draft and put in the design folder.
a11y-bot: Reminder: run automated a11y check after assets are updated to catch any regressions.
Devin: Thanks team! Small follow-up: can someone add a 3-point acceptance checklist to the top-level frame (a11y, export metadata, performance)?
